text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One dot per Primary and fold; labels mark fold 2026-06. Mean of arms M1, M2, M3 minus the Candidate, leads 24 h to under 240 h. Above 0: MSA worse. Spearman across 14 Primaries (95% bootstrap over origin days and Primaries): 2025-11 -0.19 (-0.78 to +0.47), 2026-01 -0.16 (-0.69 to +0.52), 2026-03 +0.46 (-0.27 to +0.83), 2026-06 +0.10 (-0.54 to +0.72).'
